Ana Rivera: Heads-up — AcmePay is dropping MAU velocity by ~28% week-over-week. Renewal in 45 days. Recommend we assemble a short "eject" save kit if they keep sliding. Anyone free for quick triage? :warning:
Mike Chen: On it. Can you post the usage slices? Is this across teams or just inference calls?
Ana Rivera: Mostly inference tokens and embedding calls from the payments pipeline. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/acmepay/velocity (internal)
Jess Patel: I can join. Quick question — do they have custom models pinned on Dedicated? That affects our rollback options.
Sam L: They have a dedicated pool + cache enabled, but quantization changed last month per notes in ticket #4129.
Ana Rivera: Nice catch. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/tickets/4129
Olivia (cs-bot): Reminder: Customer risk flag created (severity: elevated) by Ana Rivera.
Mike Chen: Proposed eject 'save kit' (quick list):
```
- 48h customer outreach + health audit
- Temp free credits applied to inference spend (up to $5k)
- Re-enable safe default model (if quantization regression suspected)
- Enable token-level tracing for 7 days
- Weekly check-ins w/AM + Tech SE
```
Jess Patel: Also add enablement session recording + 2 tailored prompts to surface regressions in model output.
Ana Rivera: I like adding the prompt tests. Can someone own outreach? I'll coordinate with AM.
Sam L: I'll own the model rollback check and KV cache health.
Mike Chen: I'll draft outreach + credits and schedule first check-in. @Jess can you do the enablement recording tomorrow 10am PT?
Jess Patel: Yep — booked on their calendar.
Ana Rivera: Great. I'll update the risk handoff doc and set a canary metric: 7-day active users bounce back >10% or escalate to CSM+Support SWAT. :white_check_mark:
Mike Chen: Adding follow-up reminders in 72h and 7d.
Olivia (cs-bot): Action items recorded: outreach_owner=Mike Chen, tech_owner=Sam L, enablement=Jess Patel — due in 72 hours.
Ana Rivera: Thanks team — short update in 72h expected. If the trend continues past 7d we'll move to downgrade negotiation playbook.
Jess Patel: Noted. :thumbsup:
